text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out and about with Furioso,
we spotted Hokko Tarumae,
who seemed to be doing her local idol work.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Tomakoma~☆ Hokko Tarumae's top recommendation: Tomakomai's surf clams! Please, have a bite~☆

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Even far away from Tomakomai,
she works so hard for her hometown.
That's Tarumae-san for you."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A fairly large crowd has gathered, hasn't it?
......

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh, no.
It's nothing—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—You want to try spreading the charm
of your hometown too, you say?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, Tarumae-san...!
Um... to be completely honest, I do agree, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't think... I could ever
be like Tarumae-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I don't think that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Working steadily brought me to where I am today, too—
though at first, there was a long stretch
where no one even looked my way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, what supported me was—
the love for my hometown burning inside me, that was all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I sense a kindred spirit in Furioso-san.
If you're determined to revitalize your local area—
I'm happy to teach you everything I know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—ever since then, Furioso has been
undergoing local idol training alongside Hokko Tarumae, but—
choice_data_list: Good work. Now then, today's trai—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
............
Fu... Fu~na~ba~shi, Furioso~.
T-Today I'm gonna give it my all again...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah! N-No, this is...!
Um...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. After all the trouble of thinking up a greeting, I got embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I just lacked confidence,
wondering if doing something like this could ever make me cute...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. Let's start by bringing out your natural charm.
Whether cute or cool, as long as you captivate
the audience, it's a win!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I'll do my best!
choice_data_list: ......*Ahem.* Now then, let's get to training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The lessons continued after that—and eventually, thanks to Hokko Tarumae's introduction, she got to perform at a small event.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—An' so, hope ya all come love
charming Tomakomai☆!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
My, how wonderful!
Makes you want to visit Tomakomai, doesn't it?
Next up, representing Funabashi, the rookie local idol—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
B-Bashing-Funabashi!
It's Furioso~...!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha, so youthful and fresh~!
Now then, why don't you tell us all about Funabashi right away!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Funabashi is, well...
a very charming city――
and it's easy to get to by transit――

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A-And both the fish and vegetables are delicious...!
Um...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Just be honest, and you'll be fine.
Express the feelings you hold for your home.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...F-Funabashi is!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To me, it's my most precious hometown!
The place where the people I hold dear are!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Our races are just as fiercely contested
as the Central's! And I'm working hard
right now to prove it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to promote myself with everything I've got!
I-I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, she looks pretty clumsy, doesn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, your enthusiasm came through loud and clear!
I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry you had to see me in such an embarrassing state.
I guess I really do get nervous when it's the real deal.
choice_data_list: Still, your hard work came through loud and clear!
Still, your hard work came through loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right. And there were customers who were
charmed by it too. As a persona, it totally works!
choice_data_list: Let's keep spreading that Funabashi love!
You've taken your first step as a local idol.
You've taken your first step as a local idol, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right. And there were customers who were
charmed by it too. As a persona, it totally works!
choice_data_list: Let's keep spreading that Funabashi love!
You've taken your first step as a local idol.
You've taken your first step as a local idol, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Trainer, if it's alright with you,
would you please be my manager?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm still very inexperienced...
So I'd love nothing more than to be supported by others who share my love for Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we promised to do our best together
to revitalize Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I suppose I've gone and raised
my own rival, haven't I?
However... the real deal starts now!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. I know it will be difficult, but I won't let what I've learned go to waste! I'll even go out and land jobs on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
For Funabashi!
I'll work 'bashi-'bashi hard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fighting for their respective hometowns,
the two local idols were fired up with fighting spirit.
